integrity: Exact integer and rational certificates reproduced from the embedded source code; no independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Determines integral lattice stabilizer and induced face/node-relation actions, not full algebraic automorphism group.
The lattice involution transports generic anticanonical hypersurfaces; it need not stabilize a given generic hypersurface.
The eigencharacter of the combinatorial node-relation kernel is not a smoothing theorem; historical priority remains independently unverified.
title: Involutive nodal symmetry of the exceptional Hirzebruch Batyrev mirror pair
